en: The front side of the postcard shows a colorized photograph of a European cityscape along a waterfront, featuring a bridge and several ornate, historical buildings. The words 'Gefle' and 'Parti af norra Strandgatan' are printed, indicating a specific area of the city. There is handwritten Swedish text at the bottom. The reverse side displays typical postcard formatting in Swedish, including address lines and a green Swedish stamp featuring a portrait, postmarked 'Gefle'. There is more handwritten text and a printed note indicating Vänersborgs Museum.
